E1 describes tribolayer formation in a different alloy system and does not address the fine-vs-coarse comparison. premises: Fine-grained CoCrFeMnNi forms an ultra-nanocrystalline or amorphous tribolayer under sliding in inert/UHV
This tribolayer increases local hardness and distributes load, reducing friction and wear
Coarse-grained CoCrFeMnNi is less prone to such transformation and thus has inferior wear resistance
The dynamic transformation is stress-induced and occurs rapidly under high contact stresses
